_about: Every outside tool fleet-tasks can use beyond its core (the core is in REQUIREMENTS.md: Python, SQLite, systemd, Tailscale, Ollama). One entry per tool: what it is, which features need it, how doctor.py checks it, how to get it, and its licence. doctor.py checks each one; the host scan (fleet.py scan) uses the same list; tests/test_fleet_doctor.py keeps REQUIREMENTS.md's tool table in step with this file. Addresses a site changes go in policy.json "tools": {"<id>": {"url": "..."}}; nothing here is specific to one machine.

_check_types.program: a program on PATH ("cmd"), its version from "version_args"
_check_types.http_json: GET url + "path" answers JSON; each key in "fields" must be true (the services inside it)
_check_types.venv: a Python at "python" can import "imports"; "cuda": true also needs a GPU it can see
_check_types.ollama_model: one of "models" is pulled on any Ollama endpoint in policy.json
_check_types.secret: fleet-secret list --service "service" names "name" (names only, never the value), or the env var "name" is set
_check_types.gpu: nvidia-smi shows a GPU with at least "min_mib" memory and a driver of at least "min_driver"
_check_types.inside: reported by another tool's check ("of": its id, "field": the key)
_check_types.manual: can't be checked from here; "how" says how to check by hand

tools.name: 3D print prompt tool (3d-printing-model-prompt)
used_for: design: Meshy jobs (its key stays in that app)
tools.install: https://github.com/geoffreypboals-web/3d-printing-model-prompt (docker compose up -d); then set policy.json tools.print3d.url to its address

tools.name: OpenSCAD
used_for: design: structural parts from a written spec
tools.install: in the 3D print tool's image; https://openscad.org
tools.licence: GPL-2.0 (run as a separate program, not linked)

tools.name: Blender
used_for: design: mesh repair, thickening, organic shapes
tools.install: in the 3D print tool's image; https://www.blender.org

tools.name: FreeCAD (headless freecadcmd)
tools.install: in the 3D print tool's image (freecad-python3); https://www.freecad.org

tools.name: Meshy AI (paid web service)
used_for: design: artistic parts (an approved image -> image-to-3D)

check.how: the 3D print tool holds MESHY_API_KEY in its own .env; its Meshy library sync log shows whether calls work. Spends credits: a daily limit in policy.json

tools.install: https://www.meshy.ai: an account and an API key, set in the 3D print tool (never in fleet-tasks)
tools.licence_note: who owns a generated model depends on the Meshy plan (free-plan models are public under CC BY 4.0; paid plans are private). Check the plan before selling a design.

tools.name: Image generator environment (PyTorch + diffusers)
used_for: design: a picture from the prompt, for the owner's OK before any 3D work
tools.install: python3 -m venv ~/.local/opt/fleet-image && ~/.local/opt/fleet-image/bin/pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 && ~/.local/opt/fleet-image/bin/pip install diffusers transformers accelerate sentencepiece protobuf bitsandbytes huggingface_hub pillow (pick the PyTorch CUDA build your driver supports)
tools.licence: PyTorch BSD-3-Clause; diffusers, transformers, accelerate Apache-2.0; bitsandbytes MIT

tools.name: FLUX.1 [schnell] image model (black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell)
used_for: design: the picture for the owner's OK
tools.install: a free Hugging Face account; accept the model's terms on its page (approved at once); a Read token stored with: fleet-secret set --service=fleet-image HF_TOKEN (type the name; paste the token only at the hidden prompt), or the HF_TOKEN env var on a machine without fleet-secret. KEEP THE TOKEN: don't delete or regenerate it on huggingface.co while the fleet uses it (saved 2026-10-28); without it the image step can't download the model. To replace it, make the new one first, then fleet-secret rotate --service=fleet-image HF_TOKEN, then delete the old one.
tools.licence_note: FLUX.1 [dev] is non-commercial: don't swap it in for work you sell.

tools.name: Image service (fleet-image: FLUX.1 schnell on a leased GPU pair)
used_for: design: the picture of an artistic part, for the owner's OK before Meshy
tools.install: image/install.sh (venv, one-time model download with HF_TOKEN, user service fleet-image). It takes a GPU pair through gpu_lease.py and waits for that pair's models to leave on their own: it never pushes one out

tools.name: NVIDIA GPU, 16 GB, driver for CUDA 12.8+
used_for: design: the image generator (FLUX schnell in 8-bit fits in 16 GB)
tools.install: an NVIDIA card with 16 GB or more and the 570+ driver. On a shared machine the image job takes a GPU through gpu_lease.py, so it never pushes out a loaded Ollama model

tools.name: A vision model in Ollama (gemma3:12b or gemma3:27b)
used_for: design: compare a render with the brief before it reaches the owner
tools.licence: Gemma Terms of Use (llava:13b: Llama 2 Community Licence)
tools.licence_note: both allow commercial use under their terms and use policies; gemma3 is preferred

tools.name: Voice typing service (fleet-voice: faster-whisper small.en)
used_for: the page: speak into text boxes on a phone
tools.install: voice/install.sh (its own venv in ~/.local/opt/fleet-voice; runs on the CPU)
tools.licence: faster-whisper MIT; Whisper model weights MIT
